first_failure_evidence.stderr: sha256sum: /usr/share/apparmor/extra-profiles/bwrap-userns-restrict: No such file or directory

root_cause: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runner image advanced to Ubuntu 26.04 (resolute), where apparmor 5.0.2-0ubuntu1~26.04.1 ships the vendor bubblewrap AppArmor profile at /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap-userns-restrict instead of the Ubuntu 24.04 apparmor-profiles 4.x path /usr/share/apparmor/extra-profiles/bwrap-userns-restrict. Because .github/workflows/branch-ci.yml hard-coded only the 24.04 extra-profiles path, the 'Provision real worker sandbox' step exited 1 at sha256sum before any smoke or boundary tests ran. The failure is in CI worker sandbox provisioning, not in PR #6771's source changes or scripts/git/auto_integrator.py.

fix.summary: Select the vendor-installed bwrap-userns-restrict AppArmor profile from /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap-userns-restrict (Ubuntu 26.04 apparmor 5.x) or /usr/share/apparmor/extra-profiles/bwrap-userns-restrict (Ubuntu 24.04 apparmor-profiles 4.x), verify package ownership via dpkg -S, log stat and sha256sum, load the unmodified vendor profile via apparmor_parser --replace, and retain the existing /usr/bin/bwrap capability probe and real worker sandbox boundary tests unchanged.
